kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نحرنجم (form IIIq)
# نَحْرَنْجِمُ (naḥranjimu) /naħ.ran.d͡ʒi.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْرَنْجَمَ (iḥranjama)
# نَحْرَنْجِمَ (naḥranjima) /naħ.ran.d͡ʒi.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْرَنْجَمَ (iḥranjama)
# نَحْرَنْجِمْ (naḥranjim) /naħ.ran.d͡ʒim/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِحْرَنْجَمَ (iḥranjama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
